renderContract.commonPrompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: premium work-strength action-beat guardian card master artwork, full-bleed 3:4. Show exactly the named single guardian or canonical internal pair from the approved source; never add a coworker, manager, client, recipient, extra guardian, human, body clue, reflection, silhouette, empty seat or personal belonging implying another person. Preserve canonical identity, relative size/colors, clothing, signature props, dark-purple eyes with exactly one large plus one small highlight in each visible eye, and visible chest Stella stars. Guardian or canonical pair plus the focal work device covers 55–65% and remains readable at actual width 80px. Capture only the first bounded action: one button depresses, one connector lowers, one marker lifts or one block enters a jig while the completion edge remains visibly open; never show guaranteed mastery, flawless quality, leadership rank, applause, promotion or predetermined outcome. Written work surfaces use isolated symbols and geometric reliefs only: no readable text, pseudo-text, handwriting lines, names, labels, score, number, date, clock, calendar grid, map coordinate, question mark, zodiac glyph, arrow route, logo or watermark. Do not bake actual birth-chart lines or personal colors into the master art. Every connector, bridge, marker, button, clip, wedge, block, token, lamp, thread or coupler remains removable, half-set, open-ended, unlatched or not yet applied. Only Scorpio canonical tail-heart tip is allowed; no added heart or heart-shaped light/void. No closed ring, halo, portal, infinity sign, deterministic route or completed mastery emblem. Keep every composition distinct in action camera height, first-motion vector, focal-device silhouette and open negative-space shape. Follow compositionFamily, artDirection, distinctFrom and visualReviewFocus literally. Soft colored-pencil and watercolor, visible paper grain, rounded plush proportions and deep-purple outlines; no readable text, no logo, no watermark.
